about_the_game:
Hedenite is a first-person 2D point-and-click/visual novel adventure game. It is set in an anachronistic world inspired by the city of Kyiv, its architecture, railway transport, and people.

You are eM and you just finished school in Heden, or the Lower Town, home to merchants, geographers, and smugglers. You dream of studying in Vaughis, the resplendent Upper City, and today your dream comes true: you are invited to Vaughis University! But there’s a catch: you must pass an exam in history—the only subject you weren’t taught at school. With the help of a curious magnet warping space and time, you’ll turn the streets of Heden into history books to reveal forgotten mysteries that will change everything.

Hand-drawn world you’ll want to stay in

Explore the scruffy yet charming fantasy world hand-painted by award-winning Ukrainian illustrators Anna Ivanenko and Jenya Polosina!

Captivating story told with quirky humor

Engage in funny dialogues with whimsical characters!

Game with a message about stolen history

Decolonize yourself as you unravel a story of oppression and deceit, and reclaim your agency to challenge the status quo!

short_description: Hedenite is a hand-painted adventure through a city that has lost its memory. Befriend whimsical characters, unearth secrets of the past hidden in plain sight, and smuggle yourself uptown!
